scripts.api:generate: cd ../backend && uv run python -c "import json,pathlib; from app.main import create_app; app=create_app(readiness_probe=lambda: True,identity_service=object(),session_manager=object(),allowed_origin='https://finance.test'); pathlib.Path('../frontend/openapi.json').write_text(json.dumps(app.openapi(),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')" && cd ../frontend && node scripts/generate-api-schema.mjs
scripts.api:check: cd ../backend && uv run python -c "import json,pathlib; from app.main import create_app; expected=create_app(readiness_probe=lambda: True,identity_service=object(),session_manager=object(),allowed_origin='https://finance.test').openapi(); actual=json.loads(pathlib.Path('../frontend/openapi.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); raise SystemExit(0 if actual==expected else 1)" && cd ../frontend && node scripts/generate-api-schema.mjs --check
scripts.lint: biome lint src e2e scripts vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:harness: npm run build && node e2e/support/run-e2e.mjs e2e/harness.spec.ts
